newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Telekom bids for Dutch cellular.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Telekom bids for Dutch cellular.

text.p: The mobile communications division of Deutsche Telekom AG said on Friday it would join a consortium led by Enertel NV to bid for a mobile phone licence in the Netherlands.

The Enertel group, an alliance of Dutch utilities and cable TV companies, is applying for the country's third digital cellular phone licence based on the DCS 1800 standard. The government will award the licence next year.
Deutsche Telekom MobilNet GmbH said discussions were underway with other potential partners for the consortium.

Enertel is also planning to enter the fixed-wire telecommunications market. The Dutch minister for transport and waterways said earlier this week that it would award a fixed-wire licence to Enertel next month.
